notes: Refined existing stories to handle real-world phase formats (e.g., Phase I/II, Early Phase 1) and strengthen contract clarity. No new story IDs created.

change_log.value: Expanded schema to include support for composite phases (e.g., I/II), unknown phase flags, and normalized numeric mapping (1-4 scale).
Enhanced scoring logic to support composite phases (I/II, II/III), early phase labels, and fallback scoring for unknown or missing values.
Clarified payload to include raw phase, normalized phase score, and human-readable explanation for transparency.
Expanded tests to include composite phases and non-standard labels (e.g., Early Phase 1).
Added validation for end-to-end handling of mixed phase formats and consistency between raw and scored outputs.

stories.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the data contract for trial phase quality scoring, including fields for raw phase (I-IV, composite like I/II), normalized numeric phase (1-4), score, unknown/missing flags, and explanation metadata for transparency.

stories.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to map clinical trial phases (I, II, III, IV, Early Phase 1, and composite phases like I/II, II/III) to a normalized quality score reflecting maturity and validation strength, including fallback handling for missing or non-standard values.

stories.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate trial phase quality scoring into the evaluate_care_facade so that clinical trial results include raw phase, normalized score, and a human-readable explanation describing what the phase implies about trial maturity.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating correct score assignment for each trial phase (I-IV), composite phases (I/II, II/III), early phase labels, and edge cases such as missing, null, or malformed phase values.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Trial Phase Quality Signal
stories.description: Validate that clinical trial search results flow through the system with correct phase extraction, normalization, scoring, and facade exposure, including mixed and non-standard phase formats, ensuring consistency across the pipeline.
